verdict.rationale: Claude is itself the built-in assistant, and first-party docs describe explicit delegation. In Cowork you describe an outcome, step away, and return to finished work, and Claude executes complex multi-step tasks on your behalf. Scheduled or on-demand delegated tasks, browser and computer use, and agentic Research round this out. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Cowork task delegation, since community evidence is limited to coding-model anecdotes.
